response.justification: The candidate is a strong, experienced software engineer with broad full-stack, web, and systems experience, but he has no demonstrated background in embedded/LAN-switch security features, Linux kernel source modification, MACsec/802.1X/networking protocols, or the required native-level Japanese proficiency, making him a poor match for this specialized role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated C/C++ experience (National Instruments, embedded audio project) showing some low-level capability
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and technical leadership (staff/senior roles, workshops, talks)
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, which is a hard requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification experience or embedded networking/security work
No mention of security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection) or switch/networking domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: No embedded Linux kernel / networking security experience
